description: Generate realistic fake rows — names, emails, phones, addresses — for testing. Copy or download as CSV.

faqs.a: Each row has a full name, email, phone number, street address, city, and country — all randomly combined.
1, 5, 10, 25, or 50 rows per batch. Press Generate again for a fresh set.
faqs.q: How many rows can I make?

faqs.a: Press Download CSV to save a comma-separated file, or Copy CSV to put it on your clipboard.
faqs.q: How do I export the data?

howto: Choose how many rows you need.
Copy or download the results as CSV.
title: Dummy Data Generator
